name: local-review
description: Reviews your pull requests on this machine with the agent and model you choose, in a sandbox that cannot write or reach GitHub, and puts the findings in the pull request view. Nothing is posted.

settings.label: Repositories
settings.description: Only pull requests in these are picked up by their label.

settings.label: Agent
settings.description: Any agent CLI installed here. Experimental ones are marked.

settings.label: Model
settings.description: Handed to the agent as it is. Empty uses its default.

settings.label: How to review
settings.description: Three plain ones ship. Pick "my own prompt" to write yours below.

options.label: Security — what an attacker could do
Clean code and tests — the next reader

settings.label: My own prompt
settings.description: Only HOW to review — the rest is added around it.
settings.placeholder: Review this pull request the way…

settings.label: Anything to add
settings.description: Pasted at the end of whichever prompt is in use.
settings.placeholder: Flag any new environment variable that is not in the deployment template.

settings.label: Label that asks for a review
settings.description: Put it on a pull request and every push is reviewed.

settings.label: Only my pull requests
settings.description: Somebody else's labelled pull request is ignored.

settings.label: Review drafts too
settings.description: Drafts are skipped unless this is on.

settings.label: Check GitHub every (seconds)
settings.description: How often it looks for labelled pull requests.
